note: These are the prompts for a first-try compile baseline. Do not edit a prompt between the run you are scoring and the notes you keep.

prompts.title: Advanced Combat System
prompts.prompt: A third-person melee combat system with combo chains, directional attacks, hit reactions, hitstop, and a damage type enum. Uses an ActorComponent attached to the player Character.

prompts.title: Grid Inventory
prompts.prompt: A slot-based grid inventory system (like Resident Evil) with stackable items, item tooltips, drag-and-drop between slots, and a lightweight DataAsset for item definitions.

prompts.title: Branching Dialogue & Quests
prompts.prompt: A branching dialogue system with speaker lines, player choices, condition-gated branches, quest-stage flag updates, and a DataTable-driven conversation graph.

prompts.title: Behavior Tree AI Guard
prompts.prompt: An AI guard pawn using a Behavior Tree and Blackboard with patrol route, sight/hearing perception, chase, investigate-last-known-position, and return-to-post states.

prompts.title: Save / Load Game State
prompts.prompt: A robust save/load subsystem with multiple save slots, autosave timer, versioned USaveGame struct, async disk I/O, and a Blueprint-friendly API.

prompts.title: Vehicle Physics Controller
prompts.prompt: A Chaos Vehicles arcade car controller with throttle, brake, handbrake drift, automatic gear shifting, boost ability, and tire smoke VFX hooks.

prompts.title: Gameplay Ability System
prompts.prompt: A Gameplay Ability System setup with an AttributeSet (Health, Mana, Stamina), three granted GameplayAbilities (Dash, Fireball, Heal), cooldown & cost GEs, and a tag-driven cancellation policy.

prompts.title: Interaction System
prompts.prompt: A first-person interaction system using a line trace from the camera, a BPI_Interactable interface, dynamic prompt widgets, and a post-process outline on focused actors.

prompts.title: Tactical FPS Weapon
prompts.prompt: A tactical first-person weapon component for a Character in a blank UE 5.8 C++ project. Include a hitscan rifle and one projectile grenade mode, aim-down-sights that changes camera FOV, a data-driven recoil pattern, magazine reload that keeps a round in the chamber, ammo types defined in a primary Data Asset, and a short tracer. Use Enhanced Input for fire, aim, and reload. No marketplace plugins. The component must compile against engine modules only.

prompts.title: GAS Character
prompts.prompt: A Gameplay Ability System character pawn for a blank UE 5.8 C++ project with the GameplayAbilities plugin enabled. Build an ACharacter that owns an AbilitySystemComponent, an AttributeSet with Health, Stamina, and Armor, and three startup abilities granted on possess: sprint, melee, and heal. Add a GameplayEffect for instant damage and one for stamina regen. Use gameplay tags State.Sprinting and State.Dead. No marketplace plugins. Header and source must compile in that blank C++ project.
